declaration.expectedEffect: Every owner can assess each envelope they created until it reaches Completed. Administrators can assess any envelope. The report is bilingual, sanitised and read-only; the Gateway is the authorization boundary.
prohibitedChanges: Do not change, reassign, delete, overwrite or recreate any signature, signer record, field assignment or signing audit event.
Do not automatically retry signing or finalisation; do not add guided recovery actions in PR A.
Do not set an envelope to Completed or change any envelope status.
Do not write to envelope, signer, field, token, hash, certificate or archive records during assessment GET requests.
Do not change signing rules, token/link formats, sessions, signer identity, field assignment, stamping, PDF generation, hash, certificate or archive logic.
Do not change Firestore rules, secrets, environment variables, SMTP settings or branch protection.
Do not modify any real production envelope or its signatures.

behaviourDifferences: Owner assessment is generalised from one fixed envelope to all non-Completed envelopes created by the owner; admin can assess any envelope.
Bilingual report and per-envelope Check this document entry point are added; no recovery action controls are added.
